method.walk_forward: calendar-year expanding window, prior history only
method.primary_test: paired Brier improvement vs same signed streak baseline
method.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all cell x horizon tests within each index
method.fdr_pass: q <= 0.10 plus positive Brier improvement, positive median-MAE improvement, >=60% positive test years, OOS N>=50
method.strong_pass: q <= 0.05 plus >=2/3 positive test years and OOS N>=80

interpretation: After purge/gap, forward-only evaluation and multiple-testing correction, the earlier Nasdaq D2/D3 discovery candidates do not survive. Only one S&P 500 T+5 state remains at the FDR pass level, and none meet the stronger confirmation threshold.
